intro.heading: Internationally Recognised. Clinically Verified.
intro.text: Cambridge Hospital's accreditations are not marketing credentials, they are externally audited, periodically renewed clinical standards that govern every protocol, every patient pathway, and every care environment across the network. They exist to protect patients, not to differentiate press releases.

blocks.text: The international benchmark for rehabilitation services. CARF accreditation confirms that Cambridge Hospital's rehabilitation programmes meet globally recognised standards for patient outcomes, clinical process, and service delivery. Both UAE and KSA facilities are CARF-accredited.
